entries.clue: Hooded four-wheeled cot pushed round the park by a proud parent

Tear a hall apart hunting valuables, a verb Old Norse gave English
Small room at the back where the projectionist threads the reels
Unfree labourer on a Norse farm, lowest of the social heap
Black bird of the battlefield stitched on a feared war banner
Bell-jingling folk dance performed with hankies and sticks
Bounder with a sports car who treats ladies abominably
Stinging hedgerow plant; a Dorset inn crowns whoever eats the most
